g.text: D1 | Which epithelial programs accompany lesion context?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Reference-compatible AT2-like populations; histology does not establish malignant-cell identity

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: A: centered log2(CPM+1), 2,000 variable expressed genes; no histology-directed feature selection or batch correction.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: B-D: existing primary TMM scores, uncertainty <=0.2 and >=50 cells; bars in B are medians and diamonds in C are means.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: The HPCS score also increases in repair/IPF comparisons. Different panels reuse patients; these are not progression trajectories.
